files_summary.api/posts.json: Array of blog posts (id, title, author, body).
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: get_index_html
tool_schemas.description: Serves the site’s index page as-is and returns the raw HTML content. It refuses requests that cannot resolve the index document (for example if the page is not present or not readable by the service).

tool_schemas.name: get_bootstrap_css
tool_schemas.description: Serves the bundled Bootstrap stylesheet and returns its raw CSS content. It refuses requests when the stylesheet asset is missing or not readable by the service.

tool_schemas.name: get_posts_json
tool_schemas.description: Returns the published posts as a parsed JSON array of post objects. It refuses requests if the posts collection cannot be loaded or is not valid JSON in the expected array form.

tool_schemas.name: get_nginx_config
tool_schemas.description: Returns the active Nginx configuration content as raw text. It refuses requests when the configuration is not available to be read by this service.

tool_schemas.name: get_readme
tool_schemas.description: Returns the service README content as raw Markdown text. It refuses requests when the README document is missing or not readable.

tool_schemas.name: list_static_files
tool_schemas.description: Lists static files available under the web root, optionally limited to those whose paths start with the provided prefix, and returns their relative paths. It refuses requests with a prefix that is not a string, is not a valid relative path, or attempts to traverse outside the web root. It also refuses requests when the prefix does not resolve to an accessible location under the web root.

prefix.description: Optional path prefix (relative to the web root) to limit which static files are listed.

metadata.name: Harborlight Content Hub
metadata.description: Publishes and serves a small curated set of authored posts and supporting static assets for display on a website.
